doc.title: Epic 20: Annie Web UI
doc.snippet: Implement the core responsive layout with header, sidebar, and main content area. Responsive breakpoints: <768px single column hamburger, 768-1024px collapsed sidebar (icons only), >1024px full two-column layout.

doc.title: Epic 20 Technical Context
doc.snippet: Web UI directory structure: web/src/components/layout/ contains Header.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, MainContent.tsx, Layout.tsx. Technology stack: Vite + React 18, shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS, Zustand for state.

doc.title: Epic 20 Technical Context
doc.snippet: AppState includes sidebarOpen: boolean, sidebarCollapsed: boolean (tablet view), darkMode: 'system' | 'light' | 'dark', toggleSidebar/setSidebarCollapsed/setDarkMode actions.

doc.title: Architecture Plan
doc.snippet: Key endpoints: POST /api/chat, GET /api/stream/{conversation_id} (SSE), GET /health. Web UI will integrate with these existing backend endpoints.

doc.title: Testing Strategy
doc.snippet: Unit tests: Fast (<1s), no external dependencies, use mocks. Target 90%+ coverage for core components. Integration tests: 1-5s, real services where possible.

doc.title: Project Instructions
doc.snippet: Web UI communicates with Backend API via HTTP/SSE. Backend handles chat logic, LLM integration, MCP tool execution. Redis for state management.

doc.title: Epic 20: Annie Web UI
doc.snippet: Color palette - Light: Background #FFFFFF, Sidebar #F5F5F5, Accent #7C3AED. Dark: Background #0F0F0F, Sidebar #1A1A1A, Accent #A78BFA.

doc.title: Epic 20: Annie Web UI
doc.snippet: Framework: Vite + React 18 (simple, fast builds). UI Components: shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS. State: Zustand. Deployment: Docker + Nginx for SPA routing.

file.reason: Response model showing conversation_id, status, stream_url, timestamp - Web UI will receive this from POST /api/chat
SSE streaming endpoint /api/stream/{conversation_id} - Web UI will connect to this for real-time response streaming
FastAPI application setup - includes health endpoint at /health that Web UI will poll for status indicators
Existing Docker Compose configuration - Web service will be added here following same patterns (healthcheck, networks, restart policy)

constraints.constraint: Use Vite + React 18 with TypeScript - no Next.js SSR complexity needed for SPA
Use shadcn/ui components with Tailwind CSS for consistent styling and full control
State management via Zustand with simple mental model - no Redux complexity
Tailwind dark mode with 'class' strategy for system preference detection
Follow existing Docker Compose patterns: healthcheck, restart: unless-stopped, named networks
Support prefers-reduced-motion media query for animations
First Contentful Paint <3s, Time to Interactive <5s (relaxed targets)
Jest + React Testing Library for component tests

interface.name: AppState (Zustand)
interface.signature: interface AppState { sidebarOpen: boolean; sidebarCollapsed: boolean; darkMode: 'system' | 'light' | 'dark'; toggleSidebar: () => void; setSidebarCollapsed: (collapsed: boolean) => void; setDarkMode: (mode: 'system' | 'light' | 'dark') => void; }

interface.name: Health Endpoint
interface.signature: GET /health/full -> { status: "ok", components: { backend, mcp_server, redis, llm_api, agentic_memories, langfuse } }

tests.standards: Use Jest + React Testing Library for component unit tests. Follow AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert). Mock external dependencies. Target 80%+ coverage for layout components. Test responsive behavior using matchMedia mocks. Test accessibility with jest-axe. Use @testing-library/user-event for interaction tests.
